scope: Local amd64 private operator qualification and public runtime regression with fixture RSA-signed Google-format identity tokens, native HTTP and real PostgreSQL 18. Google does not sign the fixture tokens.
observations: Both packaged entrypoints exit 1 with only startup_failed on missing configuration or unavailable attached identity with networking disabled.
Operator container runs with one CPU and 512 MiB; the public container runs with one CPU and 1 GiB.
The CLI issues, changes limits, rotates, reads status and revokes through actual operator HTTP with fixture RSA-signed identity tokens and PostgreSQL.
Public admission observes operator limits and revocation. The audit actor is the verified immutable subject.

Fixture root observer sees the operator audit insert blocked in real pg_sleep before SIGTERM; the mutation then commits and returns its one-time credential, service exits 0 under ten seconds, and SQL connections disappear.
Operator certificate retrieval uses one native HTTP fixture fetch; both output streams exclude credential/token/pepper/public-key sentinels.
Public pinned MCP client exercises exactly three tools; active quote completes during SIGTERM; SIGKILL preserves three charges without publishing the interrupted source.
Real PostgreSQL tests cover cross-environment mutation denial, duplicate public IDs, lost COMMIT acknowledgement and dropped HTTP output without automatic replay.
CLI status reports absent only for the authenticated application's exact missing-key response; proxy errors and malformed bodies do not establish absence.

earlier_container_failure.cause: The migration fixture role cannot see another role's pg_stat_activity wait_event, so the SQL-stage observer never detected PgSleep. A direct probe showed null through migration identity and PgSleep/active through fixture root.
earlier_container_failure.correction: Add a fixture-root read-only observer scoped to its disposable database. No service or migration grants were expanded; same runtime image passed the rerun.

rss_measurement: Node resourceUsage maxRSS in KiB, including in-container HTTP fixtures. Not cgroup peak, sustained load, or a Cloud Run measurement.
not_established: Cloud Run IAM or real Google token forwarding
Cloud SQL TLS/IAM authentication and idle certificate refresh

verification_sequence: The full 66-test PostgreSQL suite passed before the CLI-only confirmed-absence response improvement; its 8 operator HTTP/CLI tests passed again afterward. Final repository check passed 627 tests. The final 5 container tests passed with swap disabled; only fixture memory arguments changed afterward relative to the repository check, with targeted formatting/lint completed.
swap_configuration: Both services explicitly set Docker memory-plus-swap equal to memory. HostConfig.MemorySwap is inspected and equals HostConfig.Memory, allowing no additional swap allocation.
